scope: Joined source-enumerated installation quantities and current print identities. Composite cable assemblies count as assembly items, not a claimed physical piece total. No owned-stock audit, supplier grade/torque/kit-content acceptance, collision rerun or purchase.
open_items: No new procurement, external lookup, geometry export, slicing or physical verification.
Named standards/catalog numbers are previously documented candidates, not evidence of purchase/stock/tolerance acceptance.
Some early CAD washer references are solid disks; documented nominal bores are retained as dimensional selections, not falsely claimed as rendered through-holes.
Inlet M2.5 source comment says SKU not frozen and source head is D5/H3; current docs select a smaller Bossard D4.5/H2.5 max candidate. Both source envelope and selection are retained separately.

open_items.detail: ci_mount_hardware_cad comment says host washers remain, but executable ct_original_fixed_hardware removes sh_bolts including its four washers; current input documentation agrees replacement. Counting follows composition, CAD comment not edited.

evidence.excerpt: // Original nuts/host washers remain in parent. THESE replace old screws.

open_items.detail: Output cap source models M3x16 shaft and D5.5 H3 head without a drive recess or explicit drive designation; two output screws are therefore a separate row with drive/AF unknown, not silently merged with the six explicitly socket-head route screws. Verify intended/supplied drive; do not infer it from a solid cylinder.
No selected/owned kit SKU or verified per-kit component counts; no final core/housing cut length. Stored1000/1200 catalog option is not an installation cut list.
Steel tube dimensions are specified, but source/grade/tolerances are open. Bush and thrust washer materials and sourcing are not specified.
Nominal CAD sizes do not select vendor, thread engagement quality, grade, torque or locking. No unrecorded manufacturer proof is invented.

Ferrule bearing depth, crimp details, nipple screw length/drive/torque and wire holding force remain open. Modeled tail8 mm below nipple center /5.5 mm outside body is an installation maximum, not supplier minimum tail.
